head: The head performs a small downward tilting motion and then returns to a neutral position.
torso: The torso remains upright and stable, with minimal lateral or rotational movement.
left_arm: The left arm bends at the elbow and moves toward the torso midline, then returns.
right_arm: The right arm bends at the elbow and moves in a complementary motion.
left_leg: The left leg stays planted on the ground with no significant displacement.
right_leg: The right leg remains stationary and provides a stable base of support.

head: The head remains aligned with the torso and exhibits minimal independent motion.
torso: The torso undergoes subtle forward leaning and lateral swaying synchronized with arm motion.
left_arm: The left arm swings toward the midline, with the hand moving rapidly in a back-and-forth motion.
right_arm: The right arm mirrors the left arm motion, crossing or meeting near the body center.
left_leg: The left leg provides a stable base and may exhibit slight weight redistribution.
right_leg: The right leg maintains a planted stance and may shift slightly during energetic clapping.

head: The head stays level and aligned with the torso throughout, with no independent displacement.
torso: The torso undergoes vertical oscillation and lateral expansion synchronized with limb movements.
left_arm: The left arm swings from the side of the body upward to full extension in a lateral arc.
right_arm: The right arm mirrors the left arm motion, rising and falling symmetrically.
left_leg: The left leg swings laterally outward from a standing position and returns to the starting stance.
right_leg: The right leg performs a symmetric lateral swing synchronized with the left leg.
